Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error by concluding that the final answer was Lockheed Martin, formed in 1995 by the merger of Lockheed Corporation and Martin Marietta. Although the Planner identified the Glenn L. Martin Company as the builder of the ASM-N-5 Gorgon V and correctly noted the merger with American-Marietta Corporation to form Martin Marietta in 1961, it incorrectly focused on the subsequent merger with Lockheed Corporation in 1995, which was not directly relevant to the original task. The task was to identify the company formed immediately after the merger of the company that built the ASM-N-5 Gorgon V, which was Martin Marietta, not Lockheed Martin.
